bio: At this restaurant in a beautiful historical house on the road leading to the imposing Basilika Rankweil, the culinary focus is firmly on the region. Young and ambitious Dominic Mayer and his team serve surprise menus only – diners decide on the number of courses. Fresh seasonal ingredients go into dishes prepared with a personal touch. Traditional and modern combine to form the basis of the cuisine, which adheres to leaf to root and nose to tail principles. Other plus points are the extremely friendly service and a well-curated wine list – all of the Vinothek wines are also available for purchase.
